critical_code_review_comments: design_file_seeder.py template_cabin_lake_sign — the mirrored right-side pine tree path uses a malformed 'M 1500 200 m 0 0 L 1540 200' fragment then re-uses an absolute M command; visually the right-side pine still renders OK because the transform='scale(-1,1) translate(-3200,0)' offsets it, but the inner path string has redundant move commands. Cosmetic — does not break the SVG. Worth tidying if you ever revisit the cabin template.

DXF outputs for motorcycle_silhouette and address_arrow are intentionally a single bounding plate polyline (real bike geometry would be dozens of arcs). Documented in code comments at line 207-211. Acceptable since CAM software re-traces the SVG. Worth surfacing in the design listing description so plasma shops know to use the SVG for the actual cut path.

ComingSoonTab uses raw fetch + reads 'cm_admin_jwt' from localStorage — all other admin tabs use lib/api.js helpers + 'admin_jwt'. Mismatched key name could cause 401s if the auth flow stores under 'admin_jwt' (which UsersTab uses) — verify this is intentional.
